common.tagline: Twin-sun desert world. Hutt rule, moisture farms, and the worst spaceport in the galaxy.
common.government: Hutt cartel (Jabba) with Imperial nominal oversight
common.famousFor: Mos Eisley spaceport, Jabba the Hutt's palace, twin sunsets, podracing at Mos Espa.
common.cantinaReputation: Mos Eisley's cantinas serve everyone. Watch the corners. The bartender saw what happened. He will not say.
common.standingCurrency: Imperial credits, wupiupi (Hutt currency), water credits

localContacts: Jabba Desilijic Tiure — Hutt clan head; runs Tatooine de facto.
Wuher — Mos Eisley cantina barkeep. Sees everything. Says nothing.
Ranzar Malk — pre-Mandalorian-era fence working out of Mos Espa.
insider.politicalTensions: Jabba runs Tatooine. The Empire pretends to. Tusken raids on outlying farms are a fact of life. Jawas trade in everyone else's salvage.
smugglerRoutes: Triellus Trade Route is the spice highway between Kessel and Nal Hutta
Salin Corridor connects to the southern Outer Rim
insider.whoRunsTheDocks: Mos Eisley dock-master is technically Imperial — practically Jabba's. Pay the docking fee twice.

plotHooks: Tatooine is the spice corridor's western anchor — the slave shipments routed through Indemnity-class haulers (Adv3) pass within a parsec.
Jabba and Varga are technically rivals. Varga's slave trade exists at Jabba's sufferance.
hiddenTruths: Jabba's palace contains a Force-sensitive prisoner whose origin Jabba does not understand. Decades-old Imperial contract.
The Empire has standing orders to ignore Hutt activity on Tatooine — too expensive to police, too far from anywhere that matters.
gm.gmNotes: If the heroes detour to Tatooine in pursuit of Varga's supply chain, treat it as a Hutt-territory consequence chain. Jabba does not love Varga; he tolerates him.

campaignNotes.era: 15 BBY — Jabba runs everything that matters. Anakin Skywalker has been freed for years and his name is half-forgotten here.
